summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.27/1287)

data.turoyo: ʕAmmo Išoʕ: Fašwo yarḥo-tre-tloṯo. Fašwo naqqawoṯo hul lu qayṭo. Tulanwole, han naqqa az zabəqone məmlanwo, mʕarmiwole baz zabəqone w hul d fušarwo. Əzzewo tre-tloṯo yarḥe hul d šəḥnowa briṯo. Fatwo zbaṭ (šboṭ), uṯewo oḏər ste, kətwo talgo ʕal i arʕo. E.
data.translation: Uncle Ishoʕ: It would stay a month, two, three. It would stay at times until the summer. We would clear it away; at those times the alleys would fill up, they would heap it up in the alleys, until it melted. Two or three months would pass until the weather grew warm. February would pass, March would come too, and there was snow on the ground. Yes.

rationale: New Infectum-wa box, with snow object -le and b-marked location; the full short account identifies snow and melting.

data.turoyo: Qurme annaqqa, kul qurmo haqqayṣ, mnagelan, ḥət biyya, ḥət ʕafro, ḥət kašše, ḥət dawmo, mʕarəm ʕafro, ʕafro, ʕafro, ʕafro w de de de matʕablan ruḥayna.
data.translation: Logs this big, each log on its own; we gathered them up. Put them in, put earth, put brushwood, put a tree, heap earth, earth, earth, earth, and on, on, on; we wore ourselves out.

rationale: New Imperativ box: mʕarəm with overt earth object in a sequence of work instructions.

summary: Keep II 1 füllen and its existing Detransitive Part. Pass. box. Feminine mʕaramto agrees with ʕulbe and supplies contextual evidence beyond isolated inherited mʕarmo; no new stem or box is needed.

Register bi+ʕulbe mʕaramto as a recompense collocation, not a new numbered verbal sense. /34 repeats the /29 promise, including two tokens in its full verse; it is not independent support. The single supplied /34 occurrence still receives exactly one decision.
The Part. Pass. describes an attributive result state, not an asserted filling event. English in full measure compresses the concrete heaped-container image; preserve the translation.
64/234 is already the inherited Preterit quotation, with a container suffix and bare content lirat, following mlele with a more specific heaping action. No duplicate is added.
Jan English is machine translation [MT]. Heaping is visible in the material objects, placement expressions and ʕal ḥḏoḏe, and agrees with the inherited coin example’s more specific action.

The inherited gloss füllen is semantically too narrow if read as container filling only. Its own example and Jan support aufhäufen/aufschichten; retain füllen and label 1, without creating rival piling senses.
